$Comment: The treat a trick turns into. Each costume trick in Hallows_Eve_Trick_Or_Treat names this table
as its FallbackLootable, and the Costume reward kind rolls it for the same player whenever the
costume cannot go on: already in a costume, in that very one, or under a transformation.
Keep it a table that always pays: no Chance, no Conditions and no Costume row. A costume paid
from here never rolls a fallback of its own, and a roll that lands nothing tells nobody. Sweets
pay through the Currency reward kind, since a counter wallet has no item to hand over.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Treats
